modern: Let the part of your soul which leads and governs be undisturbed by the movements in the flesh, whether of pleasure or of pain; and let it not unite with them, but let it mark out its own bounds and confine those feelings to their own parts. But when these feelings rise up to the mind by virtue of that other sympathy which naturally exists in a body that is all one, then you must not try to resist the sensation, for it is natural; but do not let the ruling part add of itself to the sensation the opinion that it is either good or bad.
original: Let the part of thy soul which leads and governs be undisturbed by the movements in the flesh, whether of pleasure or of pain; and let it not unite with them, but let it circumscribe itself and limit those affects to their parts. But when these affects rise up to the mind by virtue of that other sympathy that naturally exists in a body which is all one, then thou must not strive to resist the sensation, for it is natural: but let not the ruling part of itself add to the sensation the opinion that it is either good or bad.

explained.summary:
Your mind, the part that thinks and decides, should stay calm whatever the body feels, pleasure or pain. Keep those feelings in their place rather than letting them take charge.

Marcus is realistic: body and mind are one system, so sensations will reach the mind and you shouldn’t pretend they don’t. What you can refuse to do is add the judgement that this pain is a disaster or this pleasure is a great good.
explained.today: A toothache or a sleepless night will register, and pretending otherwise is pointless. The extra step to avoid is the story that comes after it: the day is ruined, I can’t cope. Likewise you can enjoy cake without deciding you can’t be happy without it.
